jobs.occupation: Corporate Reservations & Sales Coordinator (all genders) in Berlin (Kaufmännische Fachkraft)
jobs.description: We're building the future of urban stays. One city at a time.Homaris exists to solve one of the most persistent problems in modern cities: People from abroad need places to live, work, and just feel at home. We build and operate fully digitised serviced apartments across Germany´s major cities – next step: Europe and beyond.And a product vision — the nanopartment® — that reimagines what urban stays can look like in the smallest possible space. Revenue triples within two years — organically. No venture capital. No exit strategy. We are in this for the long run, and we build accordingly. Extraordinary people make this happen - and we're looking for one more.Your RoleYou are the person business customers and corporate partners know by name. You take an enquiry from the first message to a complete, accurate reservation, and you make sure the stay runs as promised.This is not an inbox role. You own the process end to end. You work closely with Sales, Reservations, Revenue and Operations, so every booking is commercially sound, correctly recorded and delivered without friction. Our corporate customers experience one team, and you are the reason why.What You'll DoAnswer with clarity. You respond to guests, business customers and partners quickly, precisely and with a solution in mind.Make the offer, then follow up. You create tailored offers and take them to a decision. You do not wait to be asked twice.Guide the full journey. From reservation through changes, cancellations and invoicing, you are the reference point for every question.Coordinate the details. Special requests reach the right team at the right time. Nothing is lost between departments.Back the Sales team. You handle corporate enquiries, offers and account requests, so Sales can focus on closing.Protect the terms. Rates, codes and company requirements are applied exactly as agreed. Every final booking reflects the commercial conditions.Keep accounts current. Negotiated rates, contracts and account information are accurate and up to date.Own the large bookings. You prepare offers for company stays, apartment contingents and group or high-volume bookings, and you bring them to a close.Keep the data clean. Booking, guest and company data are accurate in every relevant system. Reservation quality is your responsibility.Spot the gap early. You use digital and AI tools to find issues before they become problems.Fix the process, not the symptom. When something slows the team down, you redesign the workflow.Build what scales. You create lightweight templates and workflows that make booking faster, clearer and easier to scale.What Makes You a FitRelevant experience. You have worked in reservations, hotel sales, serviced apartments, hospitality, travel or customer service, and you have a clear drive to learn fast. Corporate, group or business-customer experience is a strong advantage.Composure under pressure. You prioritise several moving requests without losing pace or accuracy. When priorities shift, you stay structured and pragmatic.Commercial confidence. You know rates, offers and booking conditions, and you understand their impact on the business.Fluent communication. You write and speak German and English fluently, in writing and by phone.Tool confidence. You work confidently with reservation, property-management and CRM systems.Curiosity about AI. You already use digital and AI-supported tools to draft, summarise, research and automate, with sound judgement and strict attention to data privacy.Ownership. You see what needs doing and you do it. You challenge existing ways of working and help the team move forward.Presence. You are based in Berlin, or ready to be, and you value working together in person.The EnvironmentHomaris is a company with the maximum of long-term orientation. We don't burn cash to grow fast and sell. We build something real, and we expect the people who join us to want to build it with us — not to optimise for others. The pace is high. The problems are real. The team is small enough that every person matters. We're not always great at seeing and celebrating our wins. But we're working on it — and we'd love your help with that.What We OfferWe define levels by the work you own and the decisions you're accountable for, not by your title or years of experience. Beyond that: we've thought carefully about what people actually need to do their best work and live well — and we've built a benefits package that reflects that. Health, mobility, development, flexibility, and a few perks that come with being in the travel and hospitality business. Not much is missing. We'll walk you through the details when we meet.Next StepsIf this opportunity resonates with you, we’d be glad to learn more about your experience and perspective. Just send us your CV.Questions? Reach out to Natalie at karriere@homaris.de or +49 157 92465807. We value diversity and welcome applications from people of all genders, cultures and backgrounds.About usHomaris is a leading provider of serviced nano-apartments in prime urban locations and is pioneering a new generation of space-efficient apartment concepts with its nanopartment®. With more than 4,500 apartments secured under contract in cities including Berlin, Hamburg, Munich, Cologne, Frankfurt, Stuttgart, Düsseldorf and Dresden, Homaris ranks among Germany’s leading serviced-apartment brands. The company serves contemporary customer segments, including business travellers, tourists, digital nomads and corporate clients.The Homaris concept is based on the integration of a fully digitalised guest journey with maximum space efficiency, multifunctional design and intelligent space solutions. The nanopartment® is Homaris’s signature product, embodying innovative space efficiency, modern minimalism and a modular design concept that combines living, working and a sense of arrival within a compact footprint. The role sits at the intersection of compliance, information security, process management, and documentation — coordinating requirements, structuring evidence, and making our processes audit-ready. able to document complex topics clearly, precisely, and in an audit-ready way.• Structure: Systematic, thorough, and reliable — you keep track of open points, deadlines, and responsibilities without being prompted.• Collaboration: Professional and clear communicator with management, IT, legal, HR, and data protection stakeholders.• Discretion: High sense of responsibility when handling sensitive information.• Tools: Experience with tools such as Confluence, Jira, SharePoint, Notion, Excel, or GRC tools is a benefit.• Regulatory knowledge: Basic knowledge of GDPR, IT law, data protection law, or contract review is a plus• Industry background: Experience in a software, SaaS, or IT-oriented company is an advantage.• Employment Eligibility: Must be legally authorized to in Germany.How you make an impact• ISMS Development: Support the setup, structuring, and maintenance of our ISO 27001-compliant information security management system — as a coordinating and documenting function in close exchange with management, IT, HR, legal, and data protection.• Requirements Analysis: Break down ISO 27001 controls, identify gaps, assign responsibilities, and track required evidence.• Documentation: Create, revise, and maintain policies, process descriptions, work instructions, checklists, and audit evidence documents.• Audit Preparation: Compile and organize audit materials; ensure all required evidence is in place and traceable.• Task Tracking: Maintain an up-to-date action and task plan including status, owners, deadlines, and open items.• Risk Management: Assist with gap analyses, risk assessments, and documenting risk treatment measures.• Cross-Team Coordination: Gather information and coordinate with IT, HR, legal, data protection, management, and relevant departments.• Process Documentation: Document security processes such as access management, change management, incident management, backup, vendor management, asset management, and awareness programs.• Follow-Through: Track and close open points from internal reviews, external consultations, audits, and management decisions.• Stakeholder Communication: Prepare clear decision bases and summaries for management and business units.Get in Touch! Ready to Join Us? Send us your CV – feel free to include your earliest possible start date. If you have any questions, reach out to us at hr@fairmas.com – we’re happy to help.You don’t meet every single requirement or have gaps in your resume? No problem!Apply anyway – what matters most to us are your motivation, values, and personality.About usFairmas GmbH and its affiliates is a hotel software company specializing in web-based solutions for financial planning, controlling, and management reporting. Since our founding in 2003 in Berlin, our dedicated team, including hoteliers, IT experts, and professionals from a variety of backgrounds, has been supporting more than 18,000 users across 5,500 hotels worldwide.We take pride in delivering first-class service built on years of experience. At Fairmas, we foster a company culture defined by transparency, mutual respect, and strong team spirit. For us, work-life balance isn’t just a buzzword — it’s essential to maintaining long-term motivation and creativity. We firmly believe that our employees are the driving force behind Fairmas, and their ideas and contributions actively shape our company’s future.

jobs.occupation: Data & AI Engineer (all genders), PharmaHera Service GmbH (Data-Warehouse-Analyst/in)
jobs.description: Deine neue Umgebung: Behind PharmaHera is Atida - one of Europe's leading online pharmacy groups, serving over 5 million customers across 9 countries. Together with the CEPD Group, we combine more than 25 years of pharmaceutical expertise with digital excellence to redefine the online pharmacy experience: We are building a trusted, personalized health ecosystem that guides people from prevention to cure - backed by medical expertise and driven by our conviction: Pharmacy is about people. Based in Berlin, we serve as the group's competence center for Germany and the Netherlands. As a specialized partner, we manage e-commerce, marketing, IT, and logistics for our local mail-order pharmacies, such as APONEO. Our European markets run on a single, standardized data platform (our Foundation layer). Your mission for the future: To transform this data infrastructure so it is not only usable by people, but specifically prepared for AI agents that read, analyze, and autonomously act on it. The role Reporting to the Data & AI Engineer Lead, you will own the data pipelines, datasets, AI agents and tools built on top of Foundation, and you will build most of them with AI agents as part of your toolchain. The role sits one level of abstraction above the code: you specify, review and take responsibility for systems rather than typing every line. Core responsibilities Pipeline development: build and optimize data flows in Apache Airflow, from our European markets into BigQuery. Modeling in BigQuery: implement tables and views in the Foundation layer, guaranteeing KPI comparability across Spain, France, Italy and Germany. Semantic layer and data contracts: keep business definitions consistent across dashboards, models and agents, and define the schema, granularity and quality a dataset guarantees. AI-assisted delivery: use Claude Code and the Anthropic API as your everyday engineering environment -- turn a requirement into a precise specification, let the agent produce the pipeline, then review, test and own the result. Building for agents: expose Foundation through MCP tools and skills so that AIDA and our decision agents can query it reliably. A dataset is finished when an agent can use it without being misled. Evaluation: build the evals, checks and monitoring that tell us whether an agent's output is correct. Unit tests are not enough for non-deterministic systems. Data products: design data products for management, finance, commercial, operations and marketing -- reusable across markets. Visualization and reporting: work with the business team on reports and consumable datasets in Apache Superset. Code and traceability: clean Python and SQL, with every task traceable through our GitLab-Coda integration. Agent-generated code included. Your Profile & Tech Stack What You Bring to the Role (Must-Haves): Education & Experience: 2+ years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering or Data Science. AI-Assisted Engineering: Regular, demonstrable use of an LLM coding agent (Claude Code or equivalent) in daily work, plus the technical judgment to critically review agent-generated code. Tech Stack & Cloud: Solid experience with Google Cloud Platform (especially BigQuery), Apache Airflow, strong SQL, data-oriented Python, and version control via Git/GitLab. Languages: Fluent English for daily collaboration within our international team. Mindset & Work Ethic: Strong analytical skills, an independent and results-focused approach ("you get the problem and context, the solution design is yours to propose"), and a commitment to deeply understanding code rather than using AI as a blind shortcut. What Rounds Off Your Profile (Nice-to-Haves): Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol), LLM APIs, ClearML, Docker, or Apache Druid. Know-how in evaluating non-deterministic systems and using BI tools (ideally Apache Superset). Industry experience in the healthcare, pharmacy, or e-commerce sectors, plus basic knowledge of German. What we are not looking for Someone who ships code they cannot explain. Someone who needs a ticket with the solution already inside it or with full requirements in place. We act fast: you get the problem, the context and access -- the design is yours to propose. Someone who uses AI as a shortcut and doesn't understand the problem they are solving. Someone who only thinks short-term. We build future-proof solutions. What You'll Get Your Work Environment: Freedom to Shape Your Role from Day 1: A position of responsibility with real opportunities for growth, where you can proactively drive initiatives and actively help shape strategies. Permanent, Full-Time Position: Long-term prospects in a future-proof market. Agile Work Environment: A motivated, dynamic team and flat hierarchies with short decision-making paths that enable fast execution. Flexibility with Team Spirit: Flexible working hours and a hybrid work model (mobile work & in-office) - with a focus on our Berlin office to foster collaboration and team cohesion. Direct Mentoring: Close collaboration and mentoring by the Data & AI Engineer Lead in a technically demanding environment. Hands-on Production Tech Stack: Real-world experience with Airflow, BigQuery, Druid, GCP, and a modern production AI stack (Claude, MCP, Agents, Evals). Professional AI Tooling: First-class AI engineering tools come as standard equipment. Your Benefits at a Glance: Health & Mobility: Urban Sports Club membership at an unbeatable price and a heavily discounted BVG corporate transit pass for your daily commute. Exclusive Perks: Attractive employee discounts on our entire APONEO product range, access to a wide variety of corporate benefits, and a Selgros card. All-Round Care: An on-campus cafeteria, free fresh fruit, vegetables, and snacks every day, plus an unlimited coffee and tea flat rate. Your Compensation & Terms: For this full-time, permanent position, we offer an attractive, market-based, and competitive compensation package. We anticipate an annual gross salary between EUR45,000 and EUR55,000 p.a. Together, we will determine your exact positioning within this range through a transparent process based on the following criteria: Your relevant practical work experience in Data & AI Engineering. Your professional qualifications and specific additional skills. Our internal salary structure to ensure fairness within the team. Equal Opportunity & Fair Pay: We don't leave fair pay to chance. We compensate all team members in equivalent positions transparently and fairly, regardless of gender or any other personal characteristic. Ready to join? Ready to actively shape the future of e-commerce and data-driven healthcare at Atida? Apply now! We look forward to receiving your CV and your earliest possible starting date.
